props.Name: Difficulty
props.Source:
local diff = Instance.new("IntValue")
diff.Name = "diff"
diff.Value = 8
if(game.Workspace:findFirstChild("diff") == nil) then diff.Parent = game.Workspace end
while true do
	wait(60 * 3)
	if(diff.Value > 4) then
		local message = Instance.new("Message")
		game.Workspace.diff.Value = game.Workspace.diff.Value - 3
		message.Text = "Making the teapots less evil...Difficulty is now: " .. game.Workspace.diff.Value
		message.Parent = game.Workspace
		wait(3)
		message:remove()
	end
end

props.Name: Spawner
props.Source:
wait(2)
function spawnteapot(x, y, z)
	local pot = game.Lighting.Teapot:clone()
	pot.Anchored = false
	pot.Position = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
	pot.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(75,100), math.random(-100,50), math.random(-1,1))
	pot.Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(.3, .3, .3)
	pot.Color = Color3.new(math.random(), math.random(), math.random())
	pot.Parent = game.Workspace
	script.Remover:clone().Parent = pot
end

local timeout = false
function onTouched(hit)
	if(timeout == true) then return end
	humanoid = hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid~=nil then
		timeout = true
		print("Harder")
		local message = Instance.new("Message")
		game.Workspace.diff.Value = game.Workspace.diff.Value + 3
		message.Text = humanoid.Parent.Name .. " has reached the end. The teapots gain strength! They are now level: " .. game.Workspace.diff.Value
		humanoid.Parent.Torso.CFrame = CFrame.new(17.5, 43, 9)
		message.Parent = game.Workspace
		wait(3)
		message:remove()
		timeout = false
	end
end

local connection = game.Workspace.finish.Touched:connect(onTouched)

while true do
	local rand = math.random(10,15)
	for i=1,rand do
		local x = -136 + math.random(-4,4)
		local y = 20 + math.random(-4,4)
		local z = 6 + math.random(-6,6)
		spawnteapot(x, y, z)
		print("Spawned teapot at: ", x, y, z)
		wait( i / 10 / (game.Workspace.diff.Value / 10))
	end
	wait(1)
end

props.Name: Remover
props.Source:
function onTouched(hit)
	humanoid = hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid~=nil then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end




wait(1)
if(script.Parent.className == 'Script') then return end
connection = script.Parent.Touched:connect(onTouched)
wait(10)
script.Parent:remove()

props.Name: WebsiteScript
props.Source:
function onPlayerEntered(newPlayer) 
	while true do 
		if newPlayer.Character ~= nil then break end 
		wait(.5) 
	end
	script.Website:clone().Parent = newPlayer.Character 
end 
game.Players.ChildAdded:connect(onPlayerEntered)

props.Name: Script
props.Source:
function onTouched(hit)
	humanoid = hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid~=nil then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end

local children = script.Parent:children()
local connection = {}
for i=1, #children do
	if(children[i].className == "Part") then connection[i] = children[i].Touched:connect(onTouched) end
end
